# Marionette coverage needs Thunderbird config in each platform branch

When modifying Thunderbird Marionette coverage, check the default, Windows and macOS mozharness configurations. Commit 260 adds unittests/thunderbird_extra.py to all three; adding a generic test task does not itself add Thunderbird-specific coverage settings. Marionette covers startup, shutdown, sessionstore and command-line behavior that other harnesses may not reach. Current accepted marionette.yml retains the Thunderbird config. This study did not run CI.

Scope: Marionette configuration.

Paths:

- `taskcluster/kinds/test/marionette.yml`
